WayArs reads order details (price, distance, time) shown on screen by delivery/taxi apps to help you decide faster. It never taps or modifies anything automatically.

WayArs uses Android’s AccessibilityService API. It is needed for the app’s core feature: automatically reading order offers on the screen of the delivery and ride apps you use, so WayArs can calculate your net profit and show a verdict (good / average / bad) in a floating overlay while scanning is on.

How it is used:
• It reads the text shown by the supported apps (and any apps you add yourself) when an order offer appears: price, distance and estimated time.
• Passwords, messages and anything you type are never read. Everything shown by other apps is ignored immediately.
• It never taps, types, scrolls or changes anything on screen, and it is not used to record calls.

What happens with the data:
• It is processed only on this device to calculate profit. Nothing is sent to a server, shared, sold or used for advertising.
• For orders you accept, only summary figures (price, distance, time, profit) are saved on this device for your statistics.

You stay in control: the service works only after you turn it on in Android settings, and you can turn it off at any time. If you also enable the optional notification access, WayArs reads only the notifications of supported apps about new orders.

"**WayArs**
Your personal delivery and rideshare assistant

Version: %1$s

WayArs is a subscription-based tool built for drivers and couriers working with ride-hailing and delivery apps.

The app automatically analyzes on-screen data and notifications, helping you quickly judge whether an order is worth taking and track your earnings in real time.

**What's inside**
• Order verdict over the delivery or taxi app: good, average or bad — and what really stays in your hand after fuel and tax.
• Statistics: real earnings per hour including waiting time, which app pays more and when, achievements and streaks.
• Day and week summaries, a home-screen widget with the Active switch and verdict vibration on a Wear OS watch.
• Wayo, the helper chameleon: answers questions about the app and checks your phone settings.
• Any country and currency, kilometres or miles, 17 languages.

**Design and development:** AP STUDIO
**Contact and support:** apstudiomobile@gmail.com
**Telegram:** t.me/wayars_app

All third-party trademarks, logos, and app names (including but not limited to Bolt, Uber, Wolt, FreeNow, Stuart, and any others added by the user) belong to their respective owners and are used solely for informational and identification purposes."

"**WayArs Privacy Policy**
Last updated: November 14, 2026

**Protecting your privacy**
We respect your privacy. WayArs is developed and operated by Arsenii Panicev (AP STUDIO), an independent developer. WayArs is designed around Privacy by Design — the core screen-analysis and rate-calculation operations run locally on your device.

**Data collection and use**
• Accessibility Service: the app uses this access exclusively to read order details (e.g. price, distance) shown on screen by the supported delivery and taxi apps (built in and added by you) in order to calculate order profitability. The app does not record passwords, personal data or keystrokes. Data read through the service is processed locally on your device, is not sent to external servers, and is not shared with third parties or used for advertising. The service never taps, types or changes anything on the screen and is not used to record calls. Events from all other apps are ignored immediately: nothing from them is read or stored. Before the service can be enabled, the app shows a disclosure and asks for your consent, and you can turn it off at any time.
• Notifications (Notification Listener): notification access is optional and is used only to detect new order offers from the supported apps while the app runs in the background. Other notifications are not read or stored.
• Order history: for the statistics screen the app saves, on your device only, for each order you accepted: the amount, currency, distance, time, calculated rates, estimated fuel cost, net profit, the take-home amount (after fuel and tax), the verdict and which supported app the order came from (e.g. Bolt or Uber). It contains no addresses, names or other personal details and is never sent anywhere.
• Settings you enter: fuel consumption, fuel price, evaluation thresholds, tax rate, partner (fleet) commission and weekly payment, currency, language and your on/off choices are stored only in local device storage.
• Free trial: to provide the one-time free trial of scanning, the app stores on your device a counter of how long scanning has run. It is not sent anywhere.
• Installed apps list: when you add an app to scan, the app shows the launchable apps installed on your device. The list is not stored or sent anywhere; only the apps you choose are saved locally.
• Floating overlay: the “display over other apps” permission is used only to show the order verdict card above the delivery or taxi app. No data is collected through it.
• App updates: the app asks Google Play whether a newer version is available (Google Play in-app updates API).
• Working time: to calculate real earnings per hour, the app stores on your device when the “Active” switch was turned on and off (kept for up to about 400 days). It is not sent anywhere.
• Wayo the helper: the helper’s level and energy are calculated from your decisions on the order card and stored only on your device. Questions you type into the helper are searched locally and are not saved or sent anywhere. If you tell Wayo your name, it is stored only on your device so that he can address you.
• Notifications and watch: day and week summaries are composed on your device from the local order history. If you turn on “Verdict on the watch”, each new order is posted as a short notification (verdict, amount, distance, app name); Android and your watch’s companion app (e.g. Wear OS, Galaxy Wearable) mirror it to your paired watch under their own settings and policies. WayArs does not send this data to us or to anyone else.
• Home-screen widget: shows today’s take-home, number of orders and per-hour rate from local data; anyone who can see your home screen can see it. You can remove the widget at any time.
• Invite code: the app creates a random code on your device for invitations. When you tap “Invite”, the message with the Google Play link and the code is sent only through the app you choose (e.g. a messenger). Google Play may count installs from such links in anonymous, aggregated statistics.

**Subscriptions and third-party providers**
The app offers features on a subscription basis. The app does not collect or store detailed payment data (such as credit card numbers). To process transactions and verify subscription status, we rely on trusted third-party providers:
• Google Play Billing (Google LLC): payments and transactions are handled directly by the Google Play Store. Policy: policies.google.com/privacy
• RevenueCat, Inc.: subscription status verification based on anonymous device and transaction identifiers. RevenueCat may also process technical connection data such as an IP address. Policy: revenuecat.com/privacy

**Invitations and contacting us**
If you take part in the “Invite a driver” program or contact us (by e-mail, Telegram or social networks), we process the data you send us: your account name in that service, your messages, the invite code, a screenshot of the Google Play receipt and the order number.
• Purpose: to answer you, to check that the invited driver has bought a paid subscription (we look up the order number in Google Play Console) and to grant the reward.
• Legal basis: your request and your participation in the program (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and our legitimate interest in preventing abuse (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
• Retention: invitation data is deleted no later than 90 days after the reward is granted or refused; other messages are kept only as long as needed to handle your request.
• You can ask us at any time what data we hold about you, to correct it or to delete it. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection authority (in Poland: the President of the Personal Data Protection Office, UODO).

**Children’s privacy**
WayArs is intended solely for adults who are legally permitted to work as a driver or courier. The app is not directed at children under 16 and does not knowingly collect or process any personal data from children. If you become aware that a child has provided us with any data, please contact us at apstudiomobile@gmail.com so we can take appropriate action promptly.

**Managing permissions and your subscription**
You can revoke granted permissions at any time in Android system settings, or manage and cancel your subscription directly in your Google Play account settings.

**Data deletion and retention**
WayArs has no user accounts, and we do not operate our own servers that store your personal data. Data entered in the app is stored locally on your device and can be deleted at any time by clearing the app data (Android Settings → Apps → WayArs → Storage → Clear data) or by uninstalling the app. The app does not use Android automatic cloud backup, so your local data is not copied to your Google account. To request deletion of technical subscription identifiers processed by RevenueCat, contact us at apstudiomobile@gmail.com.

**Contact**
Developer: AP STUDIO (Arsenii Panicev)
apstudiomobile@gmail.com
Telegram: t.me/wayars_app"

"**WayArs Terms of Use**
Last updated: November 14, 2026

**General provisions**
By using the WayArs app, you accept the terms below. The app is an independent helper tool built by AP STUDIO and is not officially affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by any third-party app providers (such as Bolt, Uber, Wolt, FreeNow, Stuart, or any others added to the list by the user).

**Auxiliary nature and third-party apps**
• The app is for informational and analytical purposes only. Profitability indicators (currency/km, estimated profit) are calculated from data entered by the user and readings taken from the screen.
• Users may add supported third-party apps themselves. AP STUDIO does not guarantee correct data reading for apps added manually by the user.
• Statistics, real per-hour earnings, app comparisons, achievements, summaries, the widget and verdicts on a watch are estimates based on what the app read from the screen and on the values you entered (fuel, tax, partner commission); they are not official statements from the platforms and not tax documents.

**User age**
The app may be used by people who are at least 16 years old and are allowed by the laws of their country to work as a courier or driver (taxi and ride-hailing services usually require 18+). The app is not intended for children under 16.

**Subscriptions and payments**
• Subscription payments are collected by the Google Play Store according to the selected plan.
• Users may cancel subscription renewal at any time in their Google Play account settings.
• Refunds are handled according to Google Play Store policies and rules.

**“Invite a driver” program**
• For each driver you invite who buys a paid WayArs subscription (a free trial does not count), you can get one free month.
• To get it, both of you write to us on Telegram t.me/wayars_app: you — your invite code; the invited driver — the same code and a screenshot of the Google Play receipt with the order number.
• The reward is granted after we check the order, as a Google Play promo code or a refund of one monthly payment. It cannot be exchanged for money.
• One reward per invited driver. Inviting yourself, using several accounts or a purchase that is later refunded does not count.
• We may refuse a reward in case of abuse and may change or end the program at any time; rewards already confirmed remain valid.

**Disclaimer**
• AP STUDIO is not responsible for discrepancies in calculations resulting from incorrect screen reading, or updates or changes to third-party apps' interfaces.
• AP STUDIO is not responsible for financial, business, or driving decisions made by the user based on the app's indicators.
• Users are required to use their phone safely and strictly follow traffic laws while driving.
• AP STUDIO is not responsible for any blocks, temporary or permanent suspensions of the user’s accounts on third-party services (Uber, Bolt, Wolt, etc.).
• The user uses the app entirely at their own risk and independently decides whether to use it.
• The app is an independent helper tool and has no official connection to any rideshare or delivery platform.
• Do not look at the phone or watch while driving; the watch vibration is meant to let you keep your eyes on the road.

**Contact**
Any questions, comments, or bug reports should be sent to: apstudiomobile@gmail.com."

How do I start reading orders?
Turn on the “Active” switch at the top of the home screen. While it\'s on, I watch new orders and show my verdict over the delivery or taxi app.
Why doesn\'t the card appear over the order?
In Settings → Permissions check that the accessibility service is on and “Display over other apps” is allowed, and that “Active” is switched on. Also set battery mode to “Unrestricted” for WayArs.
Why does WayArs ask for accessibility access again?
Android turns the accessibility service off when an app is force-stopped in system settings. Turn it on again, and next time stop scanning with the “Active” switch instead.
My app isn\'t on the list. How do I add it?
Settings → Supported apps → “Pick from installed apps”, then choose your delivery or taxi app.
How do I calibrate an app?
Open the app and wait for any order, then come back: Settings → Supported apps → the pencil next to the app. Tap the price, the distance and the time — done.
Which currencies are there and which should I pick?

There are 26 currencies 💰: PLN, EUR, UAH, RON, MDL, CZK, HUF, BGN, SEK, NOK, DKK, CHF, GBP, USD, RUB, KZT, BYN, UZS, GEL, AMD, AZN, KGS, TRY, BRL, INR, JPY. Pick the one your taxi or delivery app shows prices in: Settings → Currency. I convert the preset limits into it myself.
How do I set my tax?
Settings → Tax: enter your rate in %. It\'s subtracted together with fuel, so the card shows what you really keep.
Where do I enter my car and fuel?
Settings → Vehicle: type, fuel, consumption per 100 km and fuel price. Then every order shows the amount after fuel.
How do I set my own limits?
Settings → My limits: set the rate per km for bad, average and good orders. They replace the preset.

Presets are ready-made strategies 🎯 “Economy” — from 1.5 zł/km and 0.5 zł/min, “Balance” — from 2.2 zł/km and 0.8 zł/min, “Profitable Only” — from 3.0 zł/km and 1.1 zł/min. In another currency I convert them myself. Pick one on the “Presets” tab; your own numbers — Settings → Your own rate thresholds.
Where are my earnings and statistics?
The “Stats” tab 📊: orders, earnings, kilometres, average rate and real earnings per hour — for today, the week, the month or the year. App comparison, achievements and streaks are there too.
What do green and red mean?
🟢 Green card — the order pays off with your settings, 🟡 yellow — average, 🔴 red — not worth it, better skip. The rate per km and per minute is already after fuel.
Settings → Subscription. First you get 30 minutes of free trial; the subscription is linked to your Google account and managed in Google Play.
Settings → Contact us: Telegram, Instagram, TikTok or e-mail. We answer any time.

I feed on energy from smart decisions ⚡ Accept a profitable order or reject a bad one — +3, accept an average one — +2. Every working day with “Active” on — another +5, up to +10 for days in a row. Decisions give up to 60 a day. More energy — higher level!
Something doesn\'t work. What should I check?
Tap “🔍 Check my phone” at the top of this window: I\'ll check permissions, “Active”, subscription and battery and show what to fix.
Which apps does WayArs work with?
Uber, Bolt (Driver and Courier), Wolt, FreeNow and Stuart are built in. Any other delivery or taxi app can be added in Settings → Supported apps.
Does WayArs accept orders for me?
No. WayArs only reads the screen and shows its verdict. It never taps, accepts or rejects anything in Uber, Bolt or other apps — you decide.
No. Orders are read and calculated on your phone; the screen content isn\'t sent anywhere. Details are in “Privacy Policy” at the bottom of Settings.
The numbers in the card are wrong. What do I do?
Calibrate the app: Settings → Supported apps → the pencil. If it still reads wrong, send a screenshot of the order via Settings → Contact us and we\'ll fix it.
How do I move the card?
Hold the card and drag it anywhere on the screen.
What do the buttons on the card do?
✓ — you took the order, it\'s saved to your statistics. ✗ or × — you skipped it. They only tell WayArs your decision: accept or reject the order in the delivery or taxi app itself.
How is the net amount calculated?
Order amount minus fuel (distance × consumption × fuel price) minus your tax. The rate per km and per minute uses the amount after fuel.
Why is the time empty or 0?
Some apps don\'t show the trip time (for example FreeNow shows only the distance). Then the verdict is based on the rate per km.
Is the drive to the customer counted?
Yes. For taxi orders the distance and time include the drive to the pickup and the trip itself.
How long is the free trial?
30 minutes of scanning in total. The time only runs while “Active” is on. After that a subscription is needed.
I paid but the subscription isn\'t active.
Open the subscription screen and tap “Restore purchases”. Check that the phone uses the same Google account you paid with.
How do I cancel the subscription?
Google Play → your profile → Payments and subscriptions → Subscriptions → WayArs → Cancel.
Which languages are there and how do I change it?

I speak 17 languages 🌍: English, Polski, Українська, Русский, Deutsch, Français, Română, Čeština, Български, Magyar, Dansk, Norsk, Svenska, Azərbaycanca, Հայերեն, ქართული, Oʻzbekcha. To change: Settings → Language. And I read orders in any language, even if your taxi or delivery app uses another one.
How do I replay the tutorial?
Settings → Tutorial, at the bottom of the settings.
Why does “Active” turn off by itself?
The free trial ended, the subscription lapsed or the accessibility service was switched off. If Android closed WayArs in the background, “Active” comes back on by itself.
Does it work with WayArs minimized?
Yes, WayArs works in the background. The order itself must be on the screen: WayArs reads what the delivery or taxi app shows.
Can I use several apps at once?
Yes. WayArs watches all supported apps at the same time and shows which app each order comes from.
Very little: it only reads text when a supported app changes its screen. Set the battery mode to “Unrestricted” so Android doesn\'t stop it.
Why aren\'t my orders in the statistics?
Only orders you mark with ✓ on the card are saved. Skipped orders aren\'t counted.
It\'s optional: a backup way to catch orders that arrive as a notification while the order app is minimized. Turn it on in Settings → Permissions.
Does it work in my country?
Yes: WayArs reads orders in any language and currency, with km, miles or metres. Just choose your currency in Settings.
How do I reset a calibration?
Settings → Supported apps → the pencil next to the app → “Clear calibration”.
Where are the privacy policy and terms?
At the bottom of Settings: “Privacy Policy” and “Terms of Use”.

How much do I really earn per hour?
Stats → the top card “Real per hour, take-home”: your take-home divided by all the time “Active” was on, waiting between orders included. Pick Today, Week, Month or Year.
Which app pays me more — Bolt or Uber?

Stats → “Which app pays more (60 days)”: each app\'s real per-hour over 60 days, and by weekday and time of day, e.g. “Thursday evening: Bolt 34/h · Uber 26/h”. Mark accepted orders with ✓ on the card so I can count them; each app needs at least 2 orders.
I drive through a partner (fleet). How do I count its commission?

Settings → “Partner (fleet)”: enter the commission % and the weekly payment — it’s optional. Order ratings and the card over apps don’t change: Stats shows separately how much went to the partner for the chosen period and what’s left.
Where is the partner\'s weekly payment subtracted?

Only in Stats, for information: the “Real per hour, take-home” card shows the partner’s commission and the share of the weekly payment for the chosen period (a week — all of it, a day — 1/7) and what’s left after them. Order ratings are not affected.
How do I get the day and week summary?

Settings → “Extras” → “Day and week summaries”. At 21:00 (if “Active” is still on — once you switch it off, no later than 23:30) you get the day\'s result, on Monday at 9:00 — the week\'s. Notifications must be allowed.
How do I add the widget to the home screen?
Settings → “Extras” → “Add widget”, or hold an empty spot on the home screen → Widgets → WayArs. It shows today\'s earnings and switches “Active” on and off.

Stats → “Achievements”: days in a row without accepting an unprofitable order (days off don\'t break the streak), record per hour, best day and best order, badges for 3, 7 and 30 smart days, 100 and 1000 orders, 100 hours.
How do I invite a colleague and get a free month?

Settings → “Extras” → “Invite”: send the link to a colleague — your code is already in the message. When the friend subscribes, both of you write to us on Telegram t.me/wayars_app: you — that you invited them, the friend — your code and a screenshot of the Google Play receipt with the order number (GPA.…). After we check it, you get a free month.
How do I get the verdict on my watch?

Settings → “Extras” → “Verdict on the watch”. A Wear OS watch vibrates: 1 short — profitable, 2 short — not, 1 long — average. In the Galaxy Wearable or Pixel Watch app allow WayArs notifications; on a Galaxy Watch also allow notifications while using the phone, otherwise the watch stays quiet while the phone screen is on.

What do I get when Wayo grows?

Wayo grows only from smart decisions. Rewards: card themes for the order card and widget — Neon (lv 5), Carbon (10), Gold (15), Legend (20), pick them in Settings → Wayo pet. New abilities: a tip of the day from your data (lv 5), a forecast of your best times in the Monday summary (10), “better than X% of your orders” on the card (20). And 📤 lets you share a picture of Wayo with your records. Accessories drawn right on Wayo: cap (lv 3), crown (6), sunglasses (8), headphones (10), gold chain (13), legend key (16) — he wears one at a time, choose in Settings → Wayo pet.
Themes for the order card and widget, and Wayo\'s accessories. They unlock as Wayo grows from your smart decisions; he wears one accessory at a time.
What\'s new: Wayo now gives rewards for growing — card themes, accessories drawn right on him, new abilities and a picture to share your records. All of it is in Settings → “Wayo pet”.
What is WayArs and how does it work?

I’m your order helper 🦎 When an order arrives in Uber, Bolt, Wolt or another app, I read the price, distance and time in a second, subtract fuel and tax and show a card on top: 🟢 take it, 🟡 so-so, 🔴 better skip. You always decide — I never tap anything. I also count your real earnings per hour and keep statistics.
Not for the work 📴 I read and calculate orders right on the phone, and I answer in this chat offline too. The internet is only needed to buy or check the subscription and to update the app.
Is there an iPhone version? Which phone do I need?
I live only on Android 🤖 — version 8.0 or newer, any brand: Samsung, Xiaomi, Pixel, Motorola and others. There’s no iPhone version: iOS doesn’t let apps read the screen of other apps.
Will my data move to a new phone? How do I delete it?

Everything is stored only on this phone 🔒 — no accounts and no cloud, so statistics and my level won’t move to a new phone. The subscription will: it’s linked to your Google account, just tap “Restore purchases”. To delete everything: Android settings → Apps → WayArs → Storage → Clear data, or simply uninstall the app.
How do I update the app?
Through Google Play 🔄 When a new version comes out, I show an update button right in the app. You can also do it by hand: Google Play → WayArs → Update.

I have five stages 🥚→👑: Egg (level 1), Baby (2–4), Teen (5–9), Pro (10–19) and Legend (20+). Levels keep going after 20. I grow honestly: teen after about a week of work, pro after a month, legend after 4–6 months.
How do I share a picture with my records?
Tap 📤 on my card on the home screen — I’ll make a picture: me, my level and your records. Send it to a messenger or your story 📸
How do I change the card theme?
Settings → Wayo pet → Card theme 🎨 Themes unlock as I grow: Neon (lv 5), Carbon (10), Gold (15), Legend (20). The theme changes both the order card and the widget.
How do I put an accessory on Wayo?
Settings → Wayo pet → Wayo’s accessories 😎 Cap (lv 3), crown (6), sunglasses (8), headphones (10), gold chain (13), legend key (16). I wear one at a time: tap to put it on, tap again to take it off.
Can Uber or Bolt block me for this?

I never tap or change anything in their apps 👀 — I only read the screen, like your eyes do, and show a hint. You accept orders yourself. But every platform has its own rules and I can’t vouch for them — the decision is always yours.

Me and WayArs were made by AP STUDIO, an independent developer 💚 Version and description: Settings → About the app. Got an idea or found a bug? Write on Telegram t.me/wayars_app or to apstudiomobile@gmail.com.

Quoting the app:

resources.string: What exactly does the app read from the screen?

Only the order details: price, distance and time 👀 — and only in the taxi and delivery apps on your list. Passwords, chats and what you type I don’t read or remember. Everything else on the screen I skip right away; I never tap anything or send anything anywhere.
What is saved about my orders?

Only what statistics need, and only on your phone 📱: amount, currency, kilometres, time, rates, fuel, take-home, the verdict and which app the order came from. No addresses or customer names. And none of it is sent anywhere.
Is the list of my apps saved?
No 🙂 When you add an app I show the installed ones, but I don’t remember the list or send it anywhere. Only the apps you pick are saved.
Why does the app remember when I worked?
To count your earnings per hour honestly ⏱ I remember when you switched “Active” on and off — only on the phone and for about the last 400 days. It never leaves the phone.
Where do the questions I write to Wayo go?

Nowhere 🤐 I answer right on the phone, offline, and I don’t save your questions. My level and energy live only on your phone too. I only remember your name if you tell me — and that too stays on the phone.
What does the watch see — can data leak through it?

The watch gets a short notification: verdict, amount, distance and app ⌚ Android and your watch app (Wear OS, Galaxy Wearable) pass it on under their own rules. We don’t send it to ourselves or anyone else.
Can others see my earnings on the widget?
The widget shows today’s earnings, order count and per-hour rate — so anyone looking at your home screen can see it 👀 Don’t want that? Just remove the widget.
Does the app see my card and payments?
No 💳 Google Play handles the payment completely — I never see or store your card number. RevenueCat checks whether the subscription is active, using anonymous identifiers.
What is RevenueCat and what does it get?

It’s the service that checks whether your subscription is active 🔎 It gets anonymous device and purchase identifiers and may see technical connection data like your IP address. It doesn’t get your orders or statistics.
What happens to my data when I write about an invite?

When you write to us for a reward, we see your messenger name, the code, the Google Play receipt screenshot and the order number 📩 It’s only used to check your friend’s purchase and give the reward, and deleted within 90 days. You can ask to see, fix or delete it, and complain to UODO (Poland’s data protection office).
From what age can I use the app?
From 16 🔞 And only if your country’s laws already let you work as a courier or driver — taxi usually needs 18+. The app isn’t meant for children.
How do I take permissions away from the app?
Any time 🔧 in Android settings: Accessibility → WayArs, or Apps → WayArs → Permissions. Just know that without screen reading I can’t rate orders.

Almost everything lives only on your phone 📱 We have no servers holding your data. The developer is AP STUDIO (Arsenii Panicev); Google Play and RevenueCat check subscriptions. Data questions: apstudiomobile@gmail.com.
Is the app connected to Uber or Bolt?
No, we’re independent 🦎 WayArs isn’t affiliated with or sponsored by Uber, Bolt, Wolt, FreeNow or Stuart. Their names appear only so it’s clear what I work with.
How accurate are the numbers? Can I use them for taxes?

My numbers are estimates 📊 I count from what I read on the screen and your own data: fuel, tax, commission. They’re not official platform statements or tax documents. For apps you added yourself I can’t promise perfect reading — calibration helps there.
What are the rules of the invite reward?

Simple 🎁 For each friend who buys a paid subscription (a free trial doesn’t count) you get a free month: a Google Play promo code or a refund of one monthly payment. One reward per friend, never paid in cash. Inviting yourself, multiple accounts or a purchase that gets refunded don’t count.
Is the app responsible for calculation mistakes and my decisions?

I try to count precisely, but I’m an adviser, not your boss 😅 If Uber or Bolt change their screen, I may read it wrong. Taking an order is always your call, and the app isn’t responsible for account blocks on the platforms.
Can I look at the app while driving?
Better not 🚦 While driving, watch the road and follow traffic rules. That’s what the watch vibration is for: one short — profitable, two — not, and your eyes stay on the road.
Can I get my money back for the subscription?
Refunds are handled by Google Play under its own rules 💸 Usually: Google Play → Payments & subscriptions → Budget & history → the purchase → “Report a problem”. You can cancel renewal any time.
